name: MITRE TRAM — Threat Report ATT&CK Mapper import
description: Imports MITRE TRAM (Threat Report ATT&CK Mapper, github.com/center-for-threat-informed-defense/tram) results into XORCISM. TRAM uses NLP (SciBERT) to map the sentences of a finished CTI report to MITRE ATT&CK techniques with a confidence score; this connector ingests TRAM's report-export JSON and turns each report into a XTHREAT.THREATREPORT plus its sentence-level technique mappings (REPORTMAPPING), cross-linked to ATTACKTECHNIQUE so they feed ATT&CK coverage. Config (worker environment variables): TRAM_URL (a TRAM instance, e.g. http://localhost:8000), TRAM_TOKEN (API token), optional TRAM_REPORT_ID (export one report). Offline: pass `file` = a saved TRAM report-export JSON, or run with no config for the bundled sample.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.help: Maximum number of reports to import

parameters.name: min_confidence
parameters.help: Drop technique mappings below this confidence (0–1)

parameters.name: only_accepted
parameters.help: Keep only sentences the analyst accepted in TRAM

parameters.name: file
parameters.help: Offline: a saved TRAM report-export JSON to parse instead of the live API
